coverage.rule: Deterministic bounded overlap: Sao Paulo municipality, May 2000, with complete PM2.5 lag 0-2 and weather.
coverage.notes: 922 of 991 May cancer deaths included; 69 deaths on May 1-2 lacked preceding retained PM days; three grid centres contributed daily.

blockers: National 2000-2019 coverage and population-weighted municipal aggregation are unavailable in retained bounded materials; this is a bounded feasibility estimate.

design_provenance.assignment_method: Unweighted mean of 0.25-degree grid-cell centres inside the Sao Paulo municipal polygon; declared substitute for population-weighted municipal aggregation.
design_provenance.monitor_distance_evidence: Not applicable to the selected assignment method.
design_provenance.source_strategy: Official SIM annual CSV outcomes; article-linked OSF all-source PM2.5 0.25-degree product; Open-Meteo archival ERA5-backed daily weather.
design_provenance.exposure_metric: Three-day lag 0-2 mean all-source PM2.5 in micrograms per cubic metre.

coverage_policy.evidence: Report-only; retain all events with complete lagged PM2.5 and weather in this bounded slice.

design_provenance.decision_rationale: Recovered records support a stronger article-linked gridded analysis than the earlier monitor-proxy route. Bounded geography, unweighted aggregation, and holiday non-identifiability are explicit.
evidence_basis: Decoded article-linked RDS contains daily PM2.5 grid-day records.
Three grid centres fall in the municipal polygon and yield 31 daily values.
Twenty-nine complete lag/weather days and 922 eligible death strata support a fit.
